mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns negative in >50% of quarters with sustained GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL crosses above 236.25, indicating accelerating inflation, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 236.25 in >60% of instances, or t-test p>0.05 showing no effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and GDPC1 (GDP growth) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as stronger growth expectations offset higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite simultaneous FEDFUNDS up and GDPC1 up in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as easing policies amplify gains from strong labor demand.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, FEDFUNDS decline does not yield positive 20d returns >60% of the time, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, signaling tighter labor markets, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 5 trading days due to inflationary expectations from reduced unemployment.
failure_condition: 20d returns positive when UNRATE falls below 5% in >70% of instances, or no significant effect (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as rising demand and supply pressures may lead to higher inflation and Fed rate hikes.
failure_condition: 60d returns negative despite simultaneous GDPC1 and INDPRO increases in >60% of cases, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as easing policies amplify gains from strong labor demand.
failure_condition: In labor expansions, FEDFUNDS decline does not produce positive 5d returns >60% of the time, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply growth) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger production boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60d returns negative in >50% of quarters with sustained INDPRO growth, or Rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.
